pages.title: My Clips Improved
pages.description: Save Selected button moved to sidebar footer. No more full name prompt - uses source file name with optional suffix. Audio clips save full clip with effects for preview. Other file types save as effects preset only (no file duplication).

message: Media Library v2.1.1 - My Clips Fixes
notes: Save Selected moved to sidebar footer. Uses source name + optional suffix. Audio = full clip with effects. Other types = effects preset only. Fixed ExtendScript date error.
